Touch fixes for handheld screens.

- **Icon buttons no longer need a second tap.** A long-press that opened a menu right under your finger (options, context actions) was swallowing the very first tap on that menu's buttons too.
- **Vertical scrolling on Home works properly with touch.** Dragging over a card row (Continue, Recently added, ...) could scroll sideways or not move the page at all; a touch drag now goes to the right scroller.
